additional_concerns: The extraction notes about missing footnotes are stale: footnotes 1 and 4 are supplied. Their referenced external instruments remain unavailable.

Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC's 30 September 2010 FAQs are missing external authorities for the gift restriction. No dependency IDs are supplied. Their full qualifications and applicable versions remain unchecked.

node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offering in Scope. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5, node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place promotional linkage in Scope. Known absence therefore produces OUT_OF_SCOPE instead of a negative prohibition answer or positive selected-control compliance answer. Deliberate assessment exclusions remain a possible interpretation, but require reconciliation with the typed questions.

node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 combine offer-level promotional linkage with an existential non-discount gift component without expressly binding that linkage to the same component. Mixed-purpose offers could be overincluded unless supplied classifications establish that connection.

node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f limits the promoted specific product to an SFC-authorised fund. The circular supports a fund-focused context, while its quotation of paragraph 3.11 covers investment products generally. Preserve the distinction between implementing the selected circular scope and implementing the full Code provision.

For node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249, provider must identify the distributor making the offer rather than merely its funder or fulfiller. node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b explicitly requires offer attribution, but the source does not exhaustively resolve third-party attribution.

Paragraph 9 says returns or incentives may be gifts. It neither automatically classifies every guaranteed return as a gift nor exempts structured products from the gift restriction. The candidates appropriately leave substantive classification to supplied judgments; those judgments are not implemented legal determinations.

A discount exception, non-gift finding or TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT result concerns only the selected gift control. It does not establish compliance with independent disclosure, advertising or structured-product requirements.
The supplied text does not establish an operative date interval. Temporal handling of unavailable facts does not resolve the applicable historical versions of external authorities.
These pairwise NOT_APPLICABLE findings retain the separate duties; they neither authorize pruning nor establish overall executable correctness.
